build_linear_layers: build a sequential linear layer stack from a list of feature dimensions with optional final ReLU
build_conv2d_layers: build a sequential 2D convolutional layer stack with batch norm and ReLU from feature dimensions
build_deconv_layers: build a sequential 2D transposed convolution (deconv) upsampling layer stack with batch norm and ReLU
build_resblock: build a ResBlock module with residual connections and optional 1x1 shortcut conv for dimension mismatch
build_conv3d_layers: build a sequential 3D convolutional layer stack with batch norm and ReLU from feature dimensions
